maddeler.e: شَرْق أَوْسَطِيّ • (šarq ʔawsaṭiyy) (feminine شَرْق أَوْسَطِيَّة (šarq ʔawsaṭiyya), masculine plural شَرْق أَوْسَطِيُّون (šarq ʔawsaṭiyyūn), feminine plural شَرْق أَوْسَطِيَّات (šarq ʔawsaṭiyyāt))
maddeler.t:
Calque of English Middle Eastern, by means of the univerbation of الشَّرْق الْأَوْسَط (aš-šarq al-ʔawsaṭ, “the Middle East”) + ـِيّ (-iyy, nisba suffix).
Compare قُرْوُسْطِيّ (qurwusṭiyy, “medieval”), a similarly built neologism.
s: univerbation of الشَّرْق الْأَوْسَط (aš-šarq al-ʔawsaṭ, “the Middle East”)
